en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town with a broad open green or square in the foreground, lined with young trees and dirt paths. Along the street stand several two‑ to three‑storey plastered houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. One corner building has a balcony; another at right has the large sign "APOTEK" on its facade, indicating a pharmacy. In the background are fields, forested hills and a cloudy sky. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom of the image, including the town name and photographer information.
